summary: Base branch sync detection and Copilot merge-request trigger in PR babysitter.

entries.surface: plate pr babysit CLI and plate_pr_babysit MCP tool
entries.migration_impact: The babysitter now detects when a PR branch is out of sync with its base branch (BEHIND, CONFLICTING, DIRTY states) and can automatically post a Copilot merge-request trigger comment to resolve the issue. Default behavior: copilot-request strategy.
entries.agent_notes: When babysitting PRs, the tool will now detect and optionally trigger resolution for out-of-sync base branches. Use --branch-update-strategy to control behavior: copilot-request (default), local-rebase (not yet implemented), or none (detect only).

entries.migration_impact: Added optional branch_update_strategy parameter to babysit_pr(). BabysitReport dataclass extended with out_of_sync, merge_state, merge_trigger_posted, and merge_trigger_url fields.
entries.agent_notes: Existing calls to babysit_pr() continue to work unchanged. New fields in BabysitReport provide merge state information for downstream processing.

entries.migration_impact: Added 6 new unit and integration tests for base branch sync detection. All 207 repository tests pass.
entries.agent_notes: TDD approach followed: tests written first, implementation followed. Detection logic and integration are comprehensively covered.

entries.migration_impact: Documented base branch sync handling behavior and configuration options in agent operating rules.
entries.agent_notes: Agents should be aware that the babysitter now handles two types of issues: unresolved review threads and base branch sync state. See AGENTS.md for full workflow.

entries.migration_impact: Research artifact documents implementation decisions, detection approach, default action rationale, and configurability design.
entries.agent_notes: Consult this research doc for context on why copilot-request is the default strategy and architectural decisions made during implementation.
